detail.longDescription: KEDA did not originally meet the needs of the Stripe team 5 issues they identified: - poor rollout safety between blue/green deployments - limited incident response tooling (KEDA has a pause annotation, HPA has.... nothing) - limited visibility - undersized: out of the box keda/hpa is designed for small clusters - hard to use # kubecon # kubernetes # k8s # keda # autoscaling # hpa
